summary.text: Jordan Ridley is a Republican state representative who has represented Georgia House District 22 since January 2023 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election against Democrat James Shade.

paragraphs.text: Ridley earned a bachelor's degree in public policy from Georgia State University.
Ridley was a candidate in the June 9, 2020 Republican primary for House District 20, which Charlice Byrd won.
In 2022 he defeated Donna Kosicki in the Republican primary and Stacee Lashone Hill in the general election for House District 22.
He defeated Paul Kettering in the 2024 Republican primary and James Shade in the 2024 general election.

For the 2025-2026 session he was assigned to the Code Revision, Energy, Utilities and Telecommunications, Game, Fish, and Parks, and Public Safety and Homeland Security committees, and he is vice chair of Code Revision.
